name: One Thousand Yards
source:
On July 18th, 2004, Tomio “Tom” Yoshimitsu went missing. He was last seen walking down Third Street, headed to meet up with his twin brother Jamie after summer conditioning for football.

This is the Yoshimitsu family’s story. 

[From [url=https://shiroooo-dev.itch.io/one-thousand-yards]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
2004年7月18日，富雄“汤姆”吉光失踪。他最后一次被看到是沿着第三街行走，准备在夏季足球训练结束后去见他的双胞胎兄弟杰米。

这就是义光家族的故事。
